name: code-on
description: Always-on AI coding assistant for VS Code — built for your own self-hosted or OpenAI-compatible models (Ollama, LiteLLM, vLLM, and more). No vendor lock-in.

codeon.temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, higher = more creative)

codeon.topP.description: Nucleus sampling top_p (0-1, lower = sharper focus)

codeon.topK.description: Top-k sampling (0 = disabled, keeps only top K candidate tokens)

codeon.presencePenalty.description: Presence penalty (positive = encourages exploring new topics)

codeon.repetitionPenalty.description: Repetition penalty (1.0 = neutral, higher = suppresses repeated tokens)

codeon.minP.description: Minimum probability threshold for token selection (0 = no floor)

codeon.approvalThreshold.description: Tools at or above this risk level require user approval before execution (overridden by interaction mode dropdown)

codeon.interactionMode.description: Interaction mode: ask (approve every tool), autoedit (auto-approve reads, prompt for edits), relaxed (only prompt for shell commands)

codeon.assistantName.description: Display name for the AI assistant in chat. Leave empty to use the current model name.

codeon.commandTimeout.description: Default timeout for execute_command in seconds

codeon.commandBlocklist.description: Commands matching these patterns (case-insensitive substring) are blocked

codeon.autocompleteEnabled.description: Enable inline autocomplete (ghost text on typing)

codeon.autocompleteModel.description: Dedicated model for autocomplete (leave empty to use main model)

codeon.autocompleteDebounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds before sending autocomplete request

codeon.autocompleteContextLines.description: Number of lines of prefix/suffix context to include in autocomplete request. Lower values reduce token usage per keystroke; higher values give the model more surrounding code to understand.

codeon.autoSummarizeThreshold.description: Auto-summarize conversation when context usage exceeds this percentage of the window (0 to disable). Higher values delay compaction but preserve more context.

codeon.toolOutputMaxChars.description: Maximum characters per tool result stored in context (prevents context explosion from large file reads)

codeon.autoVerifyEnabled.description: Automatically run diagnostics, typecheck, and lint after file-modifying tool calls in build/debug mode. Results are fed back to the model for self-correction.

codeon.autoVerifyTimeout.description: Maximum seconds for auto-verification (split across diagnostics, typecheck, lint steps).

codeon.autoVerifyLintCommand.description: Override the auto-detected lint command. Leave empty for auto-detection. Example: 'npx eslint src/foo.ts'

codeon.autoVerifyTestCommand.description: Override the auto-detected test command. Leave empty for auto-detection. Tests are not run by default (too slow) — set autoVerifySteps.test=true to enable.

codeon.searchProvider.description: Comma-separated list of search providers to try (e.g. 'brave,serper,duckduckgo'). Auto-detected from available API keys if empty. Supported: brave, serper, searxng, duckduckgo.

codeon.braveSearchApiKey.description: Brave Search API key for web_search tool. Get a free key at https://api.brave.com (2000 queries/month). Also supports BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY env var.

codeon.serperApiKey.description: Serper (Google) API key for web_search tool. Get a free tier key at https://serper.dev. Also supports SERPER_API_KEY env var.

codeon.searxngUrl.description: SearXNG instance URL for web_search tool (e.g. https://searxng.example.com). Also supports SEARXNG_URL env var.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
